description.para: If set to no (the default), smbd checks at startup if other smbd versions are running in the cluster and refuses to start if so. This is done to protect data corruption in internal data structures due to incompatible Samba versions running concurrently in the same cluster. Setting this parameter to yes disables this safety check.

Starting with Samba 4.25 the formats shared between the nodes are protected by cluster functional levels, so all versions starting with 4.25 are allowed to run concurrently in the same cluster, even with no. Older versions are still refused.
